about.en: TIBBIR is the token of Ribbita, an AI agent launched on the Virtuals Protocol agent platform (agent 18820) and themed on Ribbit Capital. It is the ERC-20 at 0xA4A2E2ca3fBfE21aed83471D28b6f65A233C6e00 on Base, the address the Virtuals registry gives for the agent and the one centralized venues credit on deposit.
